verse.verse_1: Read (Prophet Muhammad) in the Name of your Lord who created,
verse.verse_2: created the human from a (blood) clot.
verse.verse_3: Read! Your Lord is the Most Generous,
verse.verse_5: taught the human what he did not know.
verse.verse_6: Indeed, surely the human is very insolent
verse.verse_8: Indeed, to your Lord is the returning.
verse.verse_9: What do you think? Have you seen he who forbids
verse.verse_11: Have you seen if he was upon guidance
verse.verse_13: What do you think? Have you seen if he belies and turns away,
verse.verse_14: does he not know that Allah sees?
verse.verse_15: Indeed, if he does not desist, We will seize him by the forelock,
verse.verse_17: So, let him call upon his way!
verse.verse_18: We, will call the Zabania (the harsh angels of Hell).
verse.verse_19: No, indeed; do not obey him! Prostrate and come nearer (to Allah).
